LanguageData.DigDesc: Dig up soil to place elsewhere.
LanguageData.DigDescNew: Dig up soil to place elsewhere. Hold SHIFT to lock terrain type to the first selected soil.
LanguageData.TerrainTooMoist: This terrain must have its moisture extracted before it can be dug.
LanguageData.CannotPlaceOnBridgeUnlessWaterOrThawable: Cannot place on a bridge unless that bridge is over water or (with Water Freezes installed) thawable ice.
LanguageData.CannotFillDeepOceanOnSeaIce: Cannot fill deep ocean in sea ice, too deep.
LanguageData.CannotPlaceIceOnBridge: Cannot place ice on a bridge.
LanguageData.CannotFillWithIce: Cannot fill water/wet terrain with ice (it would just melt and make it worse).
LanguageData.CannotPlaceOnWetUnlessBridgeable: Cannot place on wet terrain unless it is also bridgeable (use a moisture extractor first).
LanguageData.SRP.NoRestartWarning: The below settings take effect immediately, no restart required.
LanguageData.SRP.SandbagsUseSandTT: Patch vanilla sandbags so that they use sand in addition to cloth.
LanguageData.SRP.FungalGravelUsesRawFungusTT: Patch vanilla Fungal Gravel to cost a bit of Raw Fungus to avoid it being exploitable/unbalanced.
LanguageData.SRP.DubsSkylightsGlassUsesSandTT: Patch Dubs Skylights glass recipes so that they use sand instead of steel.
LanguageData.SRP.JustGlassGlassUsesSandTT: Patch the Just Glass glass recipe so that it uses sand instead of a stone chunk.
LanguageData.SRP.GlassPlusLightsGlassUsesSandTT: Patch the Glass+Lights glass recipe so that it uses sand instead of a stone chunk.
LanguageData.SRP.VFEArchitectPackedDirtCostsDirt: VFE Architect Packed Dirt Costs Dirt
LanguageData.SRP.VFEArchitectPackedDirtCostsDirtTT: Patches VFE Architect's packed dirt recipe to cost one soil to avoid an exploit that gives you free soil.
